eo.auswahlHinweis: Compare first, then decide. Selecting an option opens a preview and costs nothing.
eo.waehlen: Choose an option to inspect its costs, conditions and consequences.
eo.wirkungOffen: A decision is not yet a success. The next department report shows actual progress.
eo.beraten: Open deliberations; spending has not changed yet.
eo.haushaltText: Funding, political majorities and effects in one workspace.
eo.zumInhalt: Go to the selected budget view
eo.einbringenHinweis: Introducing the bill is free. Spending changes only after passage. Subsequent majority agreements may cost capital and create new promises.
eo.entwurfWirkung: The displayed budget effect applies only after passage. Ministerial reactions and supply are then tracked in the monthly report.
eo.entwurfNur: Edit draft · no immediate effect yet
eo.nachtragFolge: At once: legitimacy {leg}, minister's loyalty {loy}. The full effect arrives after {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
eo.keineAenderung: This setting is already in the draft.
eo.amtsende: The budget cannot be changed after leaving office.
eo.paketHinweis: A package replaces the current draft. You can then adjust individual items.
eo.ablehnung: If rejected, existing allocations remain in place. Paid majority agreements are not refunded.
eo.reaktion.stuetzen: Take political responsibility and support the minister.
eo.reaktion.zurueckpfeifen: Limit unilateral action and order closer oversight.
eo.reaktion.entlassen: Replace the leadership; department problems and outstanding promises remain.
eo.antwort.reden: Discuss the concern and prepare joint steps.
eo.antwort.umsetzen: Set the minister’s specific proposal in motion.
eo.antwort.spaeter: Gain time, with relationship consequences and a new deadline.
eo.antwort.ablehnen: Reject the request; the department problem remains unresolved.
